!62 = !{!"/app/example.hlsl", !"//==========================================================================//\0A// This is issue 4527: a `static const` array declared inside a member function. The pixel and\0A// mesh shaders in the report are restated here as a compute shader so that all three panes can\0A// compile the same source; the construct is not stage-specific.\0A//\0A// The two panes without an extra define fail. The failure is not a syntax error -- the shader\0A// parses and generates code, and it is DXIL validation that rejects the result, naming the\0A// array's mangled symbol as a global with no definition and its vector element type as\0A// illegal. No object is produced, so nothing here reaches a runtime.\0A//\0A// The panes built with -D CONTROL_NO_STATIC differ from the others in one token: the local array\0A// loses `static`. That is one of the reporter's own workarounds. They compile, which is what\0A// makes the failure specific to the construct rather than to the shader or the flags.\0A//\0A// Local evidence uses the reporter's own pixel shader at ps_6_0 and mesh shader at ms_6_5, both\0A// of which fail the same way; Compiler Explorer runs Release builds and its oldest DXC is\0A// 1.6.2112, so it corroborates current behaviour rather than dating it.\0A//==========================================================================//\0A\0A// Compute-shader restatement of issue 4527, for the Compiler Explorer link only.\0A//\0A// The local evidence is the reporter's own pixel/mesh shader (repro.hlsl, variant-mesh.hlsl).\0A// This file exists because Clang's HLSL backend cannot lower SV_Target, so a pixel pane would\0A// fill with errors about the stage and say nothing about the issue. The construct under test\0A// is not stage-specific, so restating it as a compute shader lets every pane answer the same\0A// question on the same source.\0A//\0A// CONTROL_NO_STATIC removes `static` from the local array and changes nothing else, so a pane\0A// built with -D CONTROL_NO_STATIC is the one-variable control for every pane without it.\0A// It is one of the reporter's own stated workarounds.\0A\0ARWBuffer<float4> Out;\0A\0Astruct MyClass {\0A  float3 GetTestValue(uint index) {\0A#ifdef CONTROL_NO_STATIC\0A    const float3 kValues[3] = {float3(0, 0, 1), float3(0, 1, 0), float3(1, 0, 0)};\0A#else\0A    static const float3 kValues[3] = {float3(0, 0, 1), float3(0, 1, 0), float3(1, 0, 0)};\0A#endif\0A    return kValues[index];\0A  }\0A};\0A\0A[numthreads(1, 1, 1)]\0Avoid main(uint3 tid : SV_DispatchThreadID)\0A{\0A  MyClass classInstance;\0A  Out[tid.x] = float4(classInstance.GetTestValue(tid.x % 3), 1.0);\0A}\0A"}
